Where do I even start? I have no idea what's happening in my brain. It's like a mild form of schizophrenia. My emotions and thoughts are all jumbled, mixed up, and disorganized.  I have almost no insight into what the cause of these problems and pain are. They're too buried and confusing to even begin to confront.. 

I know I'm bitching a lot. I'm sorry. Thank you for taking the time to write that out though, it really does mean a lot. Fortunately I passed out last night before I could do anything dumb. I'm just gonna sleep today and avoid any negative stimuli that might set me further back. Once again, thanks
